labels.scope: EXPLORATORY: one sample per cell; no statistical significance is claimed. Differences between single cells may be noise.
labels.models: REAL Fireworks models (kimi-k3, glm-5p3, minimax-m3) in Pi 1.3 sessions; real memory builds (runMemoryBuild, Kimi root, Modal workspaces).
labels.crms: SYNTHETIC CONTRACT FIXTURES of documented HubSpot/Pipedrive/Zoho CRM v8/Attio v2 API subsets. Not vendor accounts; passing is not an integration certification.
labels.transport: Matrix/training adapters: host-authored children over real MCP on loopback (LOCAL TEST PUBLISHER, not Manufact). Adaptation demos publish via Manufact; in the adaptation records of THIS batch, Manufact-published CRM children: NONE (derived from seed receipts and post-build integration records).
labels.scoring: Primary success = host fixture oracle on full initial/final state + mutation log (reverted forbidden writes count). Answer-text evidence is secondary.
labels.successDenominator: Exact-success counts use ALL predeclared cells per target x memory condition (3 models) as denominator; missing, INFRA*, INVALID*, UNAVAILABLE-ARM and ERROR cells count as non-success. 'scored-only' rate (SUCCESS/PARTIAL/FAIL/ERROR cells) is secondary.
labels.unintendedWrites: COMPOSITE PENALTY, not a count of distinct records or physical write requests: wrongRecords + forbiddenMutations + wrongCrmMutations + createdOrDeleted (oracle field unintendedWrites, kept raw). One wrong record can contribute several points (e.g. 1 wrong record + 2 forbidden field mutations on the same deal = 3). Components in unintendedPenaltyComponents; shown as 'N (wr/fm/wc/cd)'.
labels.foreignPatterns: Per-row foreign-API-pattern counts are summed by pattern key across all CRM instances in the cell (per-instance raw counts remain in cell result files).
